mostWorthwhile.text: Finishing division was most worthwhile: the sequence connected DNA copying and extra membrane to two cells, each with a complete set of instructions.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making the membrane supply felt more like preparation than a meaningful choice, though the picture showed how it reaches the boundary.

surprise.text: I was surprised that each old DNA strand was shown paired with a newly made strand after copying.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt completely arbitrary. The membrane-making structures were not explained in detail, but the picture made their role clear enough.

continue.text: I might continue to see what the unspecialized cells become, though this short chapter mostly involved predictable combinations rather than difficult choices.
